key_idea: Compare the top row with the rows you already know.
steps: The top row has a circle, a square and a triangle.
The middle row has the same three shapes: a circle, a triangle and a square. Its sum is 11.
The same shapes add up to the same total, even in a different order.
So the top row is also 11.
